reviews.title: What Customers Say
reviews.r1: The noise cancelling is strong enough for my train commute, and the battery lasted a full work week before I had to charge it.
reviews.r2: Ordered on Monday, it arrived Wednesday. Support helped me move my files over the phone, which I did not expect.
reviews.r3: Sleep tracking is accurate and the band is comfortable overnight. I would like more watch faces, but it does the basics well.

guides.title: Buying Guides
guides.g1Body: What to check before you buy, from fit to battery life.
guides.g1t1: Over-ear models block more low rumble, like trains and planes. Earbuds are easier to carry.
guides.g1t2: Look for 30 hours of battery or more with noise cancelling switched on.
guides.g1t3: Multipoint pairing lets you switch between your phone and laptop without re-pairing.
guides.g1t4: Comfort matters more than specs. If they press on your head after an hour, you will stop wearing them.
guides.g2Title: Picking a laptop for study and work
guides.g2Body: How much memory, storage and battery you really need.
guides.g2t1: 16 GB of memory keeps a browser, video calls and office apps running smoothly together.
guides.g2t2: Choose at least 512 GB of SSD storage. It fills up faster than you expect.
guides.g2t3: If you carry it every day, aim for under 1.5 kg.
guides.g2t4: USB-C charging means one charger can power your laptop and phone.
guides.g3Body: The features that matter for photos, video and travel.
guides.g3t1: An APS-C sensor is smaller, lighter and cheaper than full frame, and plenty for most people.
guides.g3t2: In-body stabilisation keeps handheld video steady.
guides.g3t3: A flip screen makes filming yourself much easier.
guides.g3t4: Budget for a spare battery and a fast memory card on day one.
